historical_reviews.v3_1: Wistron I2C defaults to BMC/platform-management ownership. ED-04 separates missing project topology and oracle values from permanent capability blocking, while management-path criticality raises the approval and recovery bar.

original_test_intent: Validate the project-defined I2C connectivity and expected devices associated with the BMC board through an approved management or independent service route, without assuming an unstated physical continuity operation.
original_method: The project must define the BMC-board revision, controller ownership, safe access path, mux/bus/target map, permitted read-only transaction, expected response and independent recovery before any collection runs.
manual_activity: The BMC/board owner binds the BMC-board revision and its I2C route, confirms an access channel that will survive a fault, approves the target/register allowlist, and supplies any physical stage only when the project specification explicitly requires it.
required_inputs: Controller ownership and independent console/service access
BMC_BD I2C bus and mux/channel topology
Reserved management, reset, power and boot-control exclusions
Abort thresholds and recovery independent of the tested path
safety_requirements: Do not infer cable removal or continuity measurement from BMC_BD
Do not test through the only recovery channel without an independent path
Do not scan unknown buses or all addresses
Do not read side-effect registers or write/reset/change mux state
Do not clear SEL or other evidence
Stop immediately on BMC latency, reachability loss, bus lock, device loss, watchdog, power or thermal anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Record the unresolved Master and project bindings
Verify independent recovery before approving any read
After approval, execute only the exact allowlisted BMC_BD identity/status collection
Continuously preserve management reachability and complete logs
Do not perform physical manipulation, reset, write or recovery autonomously
Leave the result to the engineer
engineer_actions: Define the BMC-board route and controller ownership
Approve an access path and independent recovery
Approve targets, register reads and expected responses
State whether physical inspection is separately required
Review topology, management health and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The no-run decision is correct for current readiness, but its physical-continuity explanation is not source-backed. No generic I2C probe is acceptable because this path can affect the BMC itself.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After project approval, use the documented service/OOB interface to perform only allowlisted BMC-board identity/status reads while a separate recovery channel monitors management reachability.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC_BD, TBD procedure/criteria and two-minute planning estimates are preserved; no controller, bus, address, register, cable or measurement is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES BMC_BOARD I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish independent recovery, fingerprint BMC/board firmware and baseline reachability, capture the documented controller/mux route, read only approved identity/status locations, compare all targets and responses with the project oracle, then verify watchdog, SEL/SDR, power/thermal state and reachability remain stable.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns the absent execution contract into a conditional, bounded management-bus plan without overwriting TBD or asserting a physical test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Logical responses cover the approved BMC-board I2C path only. Connector integrity or electrical continuity is separate coverage unless explicitly required by the project specification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A bad probe on the BMC board can lock the management bus, reset attached controllers or remove the channel needed for diagnosis and recovery.

project_override_considerations: Because the target is BMC_BD, project bindings must include recovery independent of the tested controller/path. A future physical stage remains separate and cannot be inferred from old review prose; conversely, a logical read cannot satisfy physical coverage if the owner later declares it.
expected_evidence: Exact BMC_BD source key and project applicability
Complete raw identities/status responses and exit state
Before/after management latency/reachability and watchdog state
Any separately approved physical evidence and coverage delta

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Both operative fields are TBD and therefore incomplete rather than contradictory. Derived physical-continuity wording does not constitute a Master source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: BMC_BD within the I2C test set supplies a management target class, and a safe deterministic identity/status plan can be created after route, allowlist, oracle and independent recovery are provided. Those are readiness inputs under ED-04, not an irreducible capability ambiguity.

review_improvement: Separates current non-readiness from capability, rejects an unsupported physical-only interpretation, and makes the BMC board's unique management-loss risk an explicit independent-recovery prerequisite.
independent_technical_reasoning: The BMC can be both test controller and affected target-domain owner, so an unsafe scan may destroy the evidence and recovery channel. That makes generic probing unacceptable but does not force MANUAL ONLY: vendor-defined read-only identity/status access can be automated once a separate recovery path and exact route are approved. Since the Master never says to disconnect or measure a connector, physical continuity cannot be treated as its core acceptance.
